name: its-a-board-game
description: Digital board game with custom launcher and Steam release path.

scripts.build: npm run build:game && npm run build:launcher
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @itsaboardgame/game && npm run lint --workspace @itsaboardgame/launcher && npm run lint --workspace @itsaboardgame/firebase-functions
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @itsaboardgame/game && npm run typecheck --workspace @itsaboardgame/launcher && npm run typecheck --workspace @itsaboardgame/firebase-functions
